description: Fetch observations from an OECD dataflow filtered by a dimension key, optional time range, and optional last_n_observations. Returns one row per observation, sorted by dimension code and then period, carrying the dimensions and attributes that vary — each label with its SDMX code beside it as <ID>_code — and values already scaled by the unit multiplier; the components holding one value across the whole result come back once, in constant_columns. Large multi-country time-series spill to a DataCanvas table holding every column, codes included, returning a preview head of up to 25 rows — inspect columns with oecd_dataframe_describe, then query the full table with SQL using oecd_dataframe_query; without DataCanvas every row comes back inline on both surfaces. Call oecd_get_dataset_info first to learn the dimension order for constructing the key.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID from a prior oecd_query_dataset call — exactly 10 characters of letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores — to stage this result alongside that one if it spills; a result that fits inline comes back inline and leaves that canvas unchanged. Omit to let the server mint a canvas if this result needs one; a canvas_id comes back only when the result was large enough to spill.

end_period.description: End of the time range — ISO period code such as "2023" or "2023-Q4". Omit to include up to the latest available period.

flow_ref.description: Full flow reference — e.g. "OECD.SDD.NAD,DSD_NAAG@DF_NAAG_I", or the bare "OECD.TAD.ARP,DF_AEI2024_DASHBOARD" form for a dataflow published without a datastructure prefix. Obtain from oecd_search_datasets and pass it through unchanged.

key.description: Dot-delimited dimension key matching the dimension order from oecd_get_dataset_info. Empty segments are wildcards; "+" separates multiple values per segment. Example: "A.USA+DEU.B1GQ.." — Annual, USA or Germany, GDP, all remaining dimensions.

last_n_observations.description: Return only the most recent N observations per series (SDMX lastNObservations). OECD applies lastNObservations to each series before start_period / end_period, so setting end_period before a series’s latest N periods excludes those observations. Omit end_period when asking for the latest N observations. A larger value is capped at 100,000 and the response reports the reduction.

start_period.description: Start of the time range — ISO period code such as "2010", "2010-Q1", or "2010-01". Omit to include all history (may produce very large results).

version.description: Published dataflow edition, for example 1.1. Omit to use the latest edition.

name: oecd_query_dataset

canvas_id.description: Canvas handle for the staged result. Present only when DataCanvas is configured and the result exceeded the inline threshold; absent when DataCanvas is off, and absent when it is on but the result fit inline. Pass to oecd_dataframe_query or oecd_dataframe_describe.

additionalProperties.description: The one value this component holds on every row.

code.description: SDMX code of the value — for TIME_PERIOD and an uncoded attribute, the published value itself.

constant_columns.description: Each dimension and attribute holding one value on every row of the whole result — the staged canvas table included, not only the rows returned here — keyed by component ID in structure order: dimensions in key order, then attributes. These components are left out of rows. Empty when every component varies.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_flow_ref`: The flow_ref parameter matches neither the {agencyID},{dsd_id}@{df_id} nor the {agencyID},{df_id} format. `dataflow_not_found`: The flow_ref does not correspond to a known OECD dataflow. `no_results`: The dataflow exists but no observations matched the key and time range. `invalid_key`: The key holds a character outside the SDMX key set, fewer dot-delimited segments than the dataflow has dimensions, a non-empty segment past the dimension count, or a format OECD rejected. `invalid_period`: A period bound is an impossible calendar date, start_period is after end_period, or OECD could not parse start_period or end_period. `rate_limited`: OECD throttled the request rate and was still refusing after the retries, or asked for a wait longer than the call's upstream budget had left. `download_limit`: OECD refused the query for exceeding its data-download or data-range limit. `canvas_not_found`: The canvas_id has expired or was never created. It is checked before anything is fetched from OECD. `upstream_timeout`: An OECD request ran past OECD_TIMEOUT_MS, or the call's requests and retries together ran past its upstream budget — 50 seconds, or OECD_TIMEOUT_MS when that is longer. `upstream_unavailable`: OECD returned a server fault or was unreachable once the retries ran out. `upstream_redirect`: The configured OECD host answered with a redirect, which this server never follows. `upstream_error`: OECD refused the request with a status this server does not model — an authorization challenge, a rejection from something sitting in front of the API, a request read as malformed, or a method it does not implement (HTTP 501). `upstream_unreadable`: OECD answered with a body this server could not read — not JSON, or JSON whose fields do not have the shape SDMX gives them. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Reports any applied latest-N reduction, dot-only key arity mismatch, requested codes absent from the observations, and how to query the full result after it spills.

query_end_period.description: End period filter applied in this query, if any.

query_flow_ref.description: Flow reference used in this query.

query_key.description: Dimension key used in this query.

query_last_n_observations.description: Most recent N observations per series filter applied in this query, if any.

query_start_period.description: Start period filter applied in this query, if any.

row_count.description: Total rows in the result (or on the canvas when truncated).

rows.description: Observation rows, sorted by each dimension's code in key order with TIME_PERIOD last. Every row of the result when truncated is absent; a leading preview head of up to 25 rows when truncated is true — query the canvas table for the rest.

items.description: Decoded observation row: "value" — the observation already multiplied by "value_scale", the power of ten from UNIT_MULT (1 when the dataflow declares no multiplier; divide value by it for the figure as OECD published it) — plus one key per dimension and attribute that varies across the result (e.g. REF_AREA, TIME_PERIOD, OBS_STATUS), holding its human-readable label, with "<ID>_code" beside each coded one (REF_AREA: "Germany", REF_AREA_code: "DEU"). TIME_PERIOD and uncoded attributes carry no _code key, since their value is the code. An attribute with no value on this row is omitted. Components holding one value on every row are in constant_columns instead.

table_name.description: Canvas table name holding the full result — present when canvas_id is set. Inspect columns with oecd_dataframe_describe, then query this table with SQL using oecd_dataframe_query.

truncated.description: True when rows is a preview head of up to 25 rows and the full result was staged on DataCanvas; omitted entirely (never false) when rows holds the complete result. Use oecd_dataframe_query with the canvas_id for analytics over the full set.

title: Oecd Query Dataset
